description: Task 5: localise the built-in menu TITLE and option DESCRIPTIONS by resolving them through the ff-i18n t() seam at render time, keyed by menu-name + option-command, out of the PARSED MenuFile model. Built-in menus stay code-only (no translated TOML on disk). Option `command` values stay UNLOCALISED. A missing key falls back to the parsed English prose (so menus always render). Satisfies Req 7.1, 7.2, 7.3, 7.4, 4.2. Depends on FEAT-001 (the catalogue must be installed and the en menu keys must exist).
steps: Create crates/ff-desktop/src/menu_workspace/i18n_keys.rs with: `pub(crate) fn t_or(key: &str, fallback: &str) -> String` returning ff_i18n::t(key) unless it equals key (the miss sentinel), in which case fallback.to_string() (Req 7.4, 3.2); `pub(crate) fn menu_title_key(menu_name: &str) -> String` -> format!("menu-{}-title", slug); `pub(crate) fn menu_option_desc_key(menu_name: &str, command: &str) -> String` -> format!("menu-{}-opt-{}-desc", menu_slug, command_slug). The slug builder lowercases and collapses runs of non-alphanumeric chars to a single '-', trimming leading/trailing '-' (so 'Reset bare' -> 'reset-bare'). The command VALUE is only an input to the key; it is never itself localised (Req 7.3, 4.2).
Register the module: add `pub mod i18n_keys;` to crates/ff-desktop/src/menu_workspace/mod.rs.

Localise the TITLE: in crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/mod_helpers.rs, in title_line_text's TabKind::MenuWorkspace(ref mw) arm, when a loaded menu AND its menu-name (mw.menu_name_label() lowered) are available, return t_or(&menu_title_key(&name), &raw_title) where raw_title is the current mw.menu_title() value; keep the existing fallback-to-tab.title when no menu is loaded. Do not change any other arm.

Localise the DESCRIPTIONS: in crates/ff-desktop/src/menu_workspace/render.rs derive the menu-name once from the backing MenuWorkspaceState (file stem, lowered) and replace option.description.clone() at BOTH display sites -- the row Label `desc` binding and the result.focused_option description -- with t_or(&menu_option_desc_key(&name, &option.command), &option.description). Leave option.command and all other fields untouched (Req 7.3). If render.rs would exceed 400 non-test lines, extract a `pub(crate) fn localised_option_description(menu_name: &str, option: &MenuOption) -> String` helper into i18n_keys.rs and call it from both sites (rust-standards split order).
Confirm the module split keeps every touched .rs under 400 non-test lines; if render.rs is already near the limit, prefer the extracted-helper form above.
acceptance_criteria: A pure unit test asserts menu_option_desc_key("settings", "Reset bare") == "menu-settings-opt-reset-bare-desc" and menu_title_key("pom") == "menu-pom-title" (Req 7.1).
A unit test asserts t_or falls back to the parsed English fallback string when the key is absent (Req 7.4, 3.2).
A unit test (with a catalogue installed carrying one option-desc key) asserts the covered option returns the catalogue text and an uncovered option returns its parsed English (Req 7.1, 7.4).

With the en catalogue installed (FEAT-001) every title/description equals the parsed English, so the existing title_line_* and menu_workspace egui_kittest/focus tests stay green unchanged (Req 10.2 behaviour-neutrality).
option.command is never routed through t()/the catalogue (Req 7.3, 4.2); no translated menu TOML is written to disk (Req 7.2).
verification: SCOPED COMPILE (primary, machine-wide policy -- NO broad cargo test/nextest/gate): C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "cargo check -p ff-desktop *> tools\logs\feat002-check.log"  then READ the log: compiles clean (ignore the spurious Exit Code -1; judge by the log contents).
C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "cargo clippy -p ff-desktop -- -D warnings *> tools\logs\feat002-clippy.log"  then READ the log: zero warnings.
C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "cargo fmt -p ff-desktop -- --check *> tools\logs\feat002-fmt.log"  then READ the log: no diff.

OPTIONAL single fast scoped unit test for the new pure key-builders ONLY (returns in a couple of seconds): C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "cargo test -p ff-desktop i18n_keys *> tools\logs\feat002-i18nkeys.log"  then READ the log. Do NOT run menu_workspace/title_line/egui_kittest suites here -- the OWNER runs the full suite manually.

Confirm no touched .rs exceeds 400 NON-TEST lines (i18n_keys.rs, render.rs, mod_helpers.rs). NOTE: render.rs is ALREADY ~487 non-test lines (over the limit pre-existing) -- FEAT-002 MUST NOT add logic to it; only swap the two description call sites to the i18n_keys helper (line-neutral) and keep all new logic in i18n_keys.rs.
findings: DONE. New module crates/ff-desktop/src/menu_workspace/i18n_keys.rs (88 non-test lines) holds: t_or(key, fallback) (returns ff_i18n::t(key) unless it equals key = miss sentinel, else fallback); private slug() (lowercase, collapse non-alphanumeric runs to single '-', trim); menu_title_key(menu_name) -> 'menu-<slug>-title'; menu_option_desc_key(menu_name, command) -> 'menu-<menu-slug>-opt-<command-slug>-desc'; pub(crate) localised_option_description(menu_name, &MenuOption) = t_or(desc_key, option.description). Registered 'pub mod i18n_keys;' in menu_workspace/mod.rs. Swapped the TWO description sites in render.rs (row Label `desc` binding AND result.focused_option tuple) and the TITLE in shell/mod_helpers.rs title_line_text's TabKind::MenuWorkspace arm. render.rs got a single `let menu_name = state.menu_name_label().unwrap_or_default();` binding (menu_name_label is uppercase; slug() lowercases it) + two call-site swaps = NO logic in render.rs; its main test module boundary is now line 496 (was ~487, the pre-existing over-400 condition is unchanged and accepted). mod_helpers arm grew ~11 lines, still well under 400. option.command is never routed through t() (only slugged into the key); built-in menus stay code-only (no translated TOML written). Keys consumed (all already present in crates/ff-i18n/i18n/en/menus.ftl from FEAT-001): menu-pom-title, menu-settings-title, menu-pom-opt-{settings,catalogs,files,help,x}-desc, menu-settings-opt-{config,theme,menus,keys,kinds,reset-bare}-desc. NO new ff-i18n keys were added by FEAT-002 (FEAT-001 shipped them). Command values -> slugs: POM Settings/Catalogs/Files/Help/X; Settings Config/Theme/Menus/Keys/Kinds/'Reset bare'->reset-bare. Behaviour-neutral at ui.locale=en: catalogue en values are byte-identical to parsed English, and on a total miss t_or returns the parsed English, so existing title_line/menu_workspace/egui_kittest tests stay green (owner proves via full suite). Scoped verification (worktree manifest, read from tools/logs/): cargo check -p ff-desktop = Finished dev profile, clean; cargo clippy -p ff-desktop -- -D warnings = Finished, zero warnings (one doc-overindent lint hit on the module doc comment and was fixed); cargo fmt -p ff-desktop -- --check = no diff (empty log); cargo test -p ff-desktop i18n_keys = 5 passed, 0 failed. For later steps (FEAT-003): tools/logs/ in the worktree is populated and git-ignored; the ff_i18n::t() seam returns the key string on a total miss (the t_or sentinel), and before any catalogue install returns the key too, so localised_* helpers degrade to English safely.
